visualReview.findings: Readable conditional review and explicit current risk; disabled stale confirmation; native faction colours, unknown/dated markers and textures preserved; actual three-site supply route; mobile 390px review actions and wrap remain usable without horizontal overflow.

limits: The declared existing-garrison exercise fixture isolates a local assault. It adds no person, stock, report or territory; all later reconnaissance, garrison, review, reservation and resolution actions use public UI.

Only own forces and accessible dated reports inform the preview. No private seed, live foreign roster/stock or future enemy order informs the conditional model. Its cases are neither a win probability nor a promised next-turn result.

Six V6 physical structures remain open: W3-S09, W3-S10, W3-S13, W3-S14, W3-S15, W3-S18. No new ship, mount, energy, duel, sound system, orbit, full RTS, campaign admission or physical phone certification is claimed.
Reviews are ephemeral and require another explicit study after reload or any front replacement; no new archive payload/version is introduced.
